scope.en: Selected occupation and liberation contexts, not a complete map of either world war. Hatching uses an existing country-reference outline for a broadly occupied country; it is not a reconstructed occupation boundary or front line. Diamonds mark a representative place or country for partial occupation and transition, not the limits of control. Years are sampled at year-end except where a record explicitly describes change during the year.
scope.zh: 选取的占领与解放背景，并非两次世界大战的完整地图。斜线沿用大部分地区受占领的既有国家参照轮廓，不是重建的占领边界或战线。菱形标记部分占领及转折时期的代表地点或国家，并非控制范围。除条目明确说明年内变化外，按年末选取。

title.zh: 比利时 · 大部分地区遭德军占领

summary.en: Germany invaded on 4 August 1914. By November most Belgian communes were occupied, while a western corner remained behind the Yser front and the government was in exile. The marker represents Belgium; it is not the occupation's perimeter.
summary.zh: 德国于1914年8月4日入侵。到11月，比利时大部分市镇被占领，西部一角仍在伊瑟尔战线后方，政府流亡国外。标记代表比利时，并非占领范围边界。

title.zh: 卢森堡 · 德国占领

summary.en: German forces occupied Luxembourg in August 1914 while Luxembourg institutions continued under the occupying power. Allied troops entered in November 1918. The hatched outline is the dated country reference, not a surveyed occupation frontier.
summary.zh: 德军于1914年8月占领卢森堡，卢森堡机构在占领当局之下继续运作。协约国军队于1918年11月进入。斜线沿用有年代的国家参照轮廓，并非测绘的占领边界。

title.zh: 塞尔维亚 · 分区占领

summary.en: After the Central Powers' offensive in 1915, Austria-Hungary governed an occupation zone through a military administration and Bulgaria occupied another part of Serbia. People faced exploitation, deportation and internment. This marker represents Serbia; it does not map the zones. The cited research abstracts were inspected, not the full chapters.
summary.zh: 1915年同盟国进攻后，奥匈帝国通过军事行政机构管理一处占领区，保加利亚占领塞尔维亚的另一部分。居民面临经济掠夺、驱逐和拘禁。此标记代表塞尔维亚，不绘制各区边界。已查阅所引研究摘要，未查阅全文。

title.zh: 比利时 · 德国占领

summary.en: Belgium surrendered on 28 May 1940. German military rule coexisted with the Belgian civil service and an exiled government; persecution and deportations affected civilians. The hatch is a country-level reference; it does not resolve annexed districts or administrative boundaries.
summary.zh: 比利时于1940年5月28日投降。德国军事统治与比利时公务体系及流亡政府并存；迫害与驱逐影响平民。斜线是国家层级参照，不能区分被吞并地区或行政边界。

title.en: Belgium · liberation and the Ardennes offensive
title.zh: 比利时 · 解放与阿登攻势

summary.en: Much of Belgium was liberated in 1944; the German Ardennes offensive began on 16 December and fighting continued into 1945. The country marker describes a changing year, not Brussels' control at year-end or an occupied perimeter.
summary.zh: 比利时大部分地区于1944年获得解放；德国于12月16日发动阿登攻势，战斗延续至1945年。国家标记描述这一变化年份，不表示布鲁塞尔年末控制状况或占领边界。

title.zh: 荷兰 · 德国占领

summary.en: German forces invaded on 10 May 1940 and the Dutch army surrendered that month. A German civil administration oversaw collaborating Dutch authorities; persecution and deportations affected civilians. Museum accounts differ on 14 versus 15 May for surrender, so this reference does not choose a day. The hatch follows the European country reference, not colonial possessions or a military survey.
summary.zh: 德军于1940年5月10日入侵，荷兰军队当月投降。德国民政当局监督合作的荷兰机构；迫害与驱逐影响平民。博物馆不同页面对投降日期为5月14日还是15日有分歧，因此此处不选定具体日期。斜线沿用欧洲国家参照，不包含殖民属地，也不是军事测绘。

title.zh: 荷兰 · 部分地区解放

summary.en: By the end of 1944, Allied forces had liberated parts of the south while German occupation continued elsewhere. The marker represents a divided situation, not a boundary or an assertion that all areas shared the same administration.
summary.zh: 到1944年末，盟军已解放南部部分地区，其他地区仍受德国占领。标记代表分裂的局势，并非边界，也不表示各地处于同一种行政管辖。

title.zh: 卢森堡 · 占领与民政管理

summary.en: Germany invaded in May 1940; the grand duchess and government fled. German military administration was followed by a civil administration. The country outline is a reference, not an independently reconstructed frontier.
summary.zh: 德国于1940年5月入侵；大公和政府流亡。德国先实施军事管理，随后改为民政管理。国家轮廓为参照，并非独立重建的边界。

title.zh: 卢森堡 · 吞并与迫害

summary.en: Germany formally annexed Luxembourg in August 1942. Persecution, deportation and resistance occurred under German rule. The hatched country outline does not separately map changing administrative districts.
summary.zh: 德国于1942年8月正式吞并卢森堡。德国统治下发生迫害、驱逐与抵抗。带斜线的国家轮廓未单独绘制变化中的行政区。

title.zh: 卢森堡 · 解放与再度交战

summary.en: Liberation in 1944 was followed by renewed fighting during the Ardennes offensive. The country marker represents a changing year, not the exact position of the front or control of Luxembourg City on 31 December.
summary.zh: 1944年解放后，阿登攻势期间又发生战斗。国家标记代表变化中的年份，不表示准确战线或卢森堡市12月31日的控制状况。

title.en: Denmark · occupation with Danish domestic government
title.zh: 丹麦 · 占领下的丹麦国内政府

summary.en: Germany occupied Denmark on 9 April 1940. The Danish government continued to administer domestic affairs until 1943 under German domination. This European Denmark reference excludes Greenland and the Faroe Islands; British forces occupied the Faroes.
summary.zh: 德国于1940年4月9日占领丹麦。丹麦政府在德国支配下继续管理国内事务，直至1943年。此欧洲丹麦参照不包括格陵兰和法罗群岛；法罗群岛由英军占领。

title.en: Denmark · martial law, rescue and deportation
title.zh: 丹麦 · 戒严、营救与驱逐

summary.en: The Danish government resigned on 29 August 1943 and German authorities imposed martial law. Danish resistance and civilians helped thousands of Jews escape to Sweden; 470 Jews were deported to Theresienstadt. The reference excludes the Faroes and Greenland.
summary.zh: 丹麦政府于1943年8月29日辞职，德国当局实施戒严。丹麦抵抗力量与平民帮助数千名犹太人逃往瑞典；470名犹太人被驱逐至特雷津。此参照不包括法罗群岛和格陵兰。

title.zh: 挪威 · 德国占领

summary.en: Germany invaded Norway on 9 April 1940; Norwegian forces surrendered in June. A German commissioner and collaborating authorities governed amid resistance. Museum accounts differ on 9 versus 10 June for surrender, so this reference does not choose a day. This country-level reference is not a map of every garrison or frontier.
summary.zh: 德国于1940年4月9日入侵挪威；挪威军队于6月投降。德国专员和合作者当局统治期间也有抵抗。博物馆不同页面对投降日期为6月9日还是10日有分歧，因此此处不选定具体日期。此国家层级参照不表示每个驻军点或边界。

title.en: Norway · Finnmark liberation and scorched earth
title.zh: 挪威 · 芬马克解放与焦土政策

summary.en: Soviet forces liberated eastern Finnmark in autumn 1944. German forces forced evacuations and destroyed settlements farther west; the remainder of Norway was liberated in May 1945. The marker is a country reference, not an occupation boundary.
summary.zh: 苏军于1944年秋解放芬马克东部。德军强制疏散并摧毁更西部的聚落；挪威其余地区于1945年5月解放。标记代表国家背景，并非占领边界。

title.zh: 法国 · 占领区与维希政权

summary.en: After the June 1940 armistice Germany occupied northern France and the Atlantic coast, while the Vichy regime governed the southern zone. German forces entered the previously unoccupied zone in November 1942. The marker cannot show the changing demarcation line or Italian-held areas.
summary.zh: 1940年6月停战后，德国占领法国北部和大西洋沿岸，维希政权管理南部区域。德军于1942年11月进入此前未被占领的区域。标记不能展示变化中的分界线或意大利控制地区。

title.zh: 法国 · 占领与抵抗

summary.en: German occupation, Vichy collaboration, deportation and resistance continued in 1943; control differed across regions. The point is a reference to Paris, not a surveyed boundary.
summary.zh: 1943年德国占领、维希合作、驱逐与抵抗仍在继续；各地控制状况不同。此点参照巴黎，并非测绘边界。

title.zh: 法国 · 1944年的登陆与解放

summary.en: Allied landings in Normandy on 6 June 1944 and subsequent advances changed control through the year. The country marker summarizes this transition; it does not claim Paris was still occupied at year-end or draw a moving front.
summary.zh: 盟军于1944年6月6日在诺曼底登陆，随后的推进使控制状况在年内变化。国家标记概括这一转折，不表示巴黎年末仍被占领，也不绘制移动战线。

title.zh: 波兰 · 德苏瓜分

summary.en: Germany invaded on 1 September 1939 and the Soviet Union entered eastern Poland on 17 September. The countries divided Poland; Germany annexed western areas and governed other occupied areas as the General Government. The marker does not draw the partition line.
summary.zh: 德国于1939年9月1日入侵，苏联于9月17日进入波兰东部。两国瓜分波兰；德国吞并西部地区，并以总督府管理其他占领区。标记不绘制瓜分线。

title.en: Poland · German rule, persecution and resistance
title.zh: 波兰 · 德国统治、迫害与抵抗

summary.en: Germany invaded Soviet-held eastern Poland in June 1941. German occupation involved mass murder, forced labor and expulsions; Jewish persecution and genocide had distinct targets and institutions. Soviet advances changed control during 1944–45. The marker is not a front line.
summary.zh: 德国于1941年6月入侵苏联控制的波兰东部。德国占领伴随大规模杀戮、强迫劳动和驱逐；针对犹太人的迫害与种族灭绝具有不同的目标与机构。1944—1945年苏军推进改变了控制状况。标记不是战线。

title.zh: 希腊 · 轴心国分区占领

summary.en: Germany, Italy and Bulgaria divided Greece into occupation zones in 1941. Treatment of Jewish communities varied by zone; after Italy's surrender in 1943 German forces took over the Italian zones. The hatch marks the country reference, not the boundaries among the occupiers.
summary.zh: 德国、意大利和保加利亚于1941年将希腊划分为占领区。犹太社群的遭遇因占领区而异；意大利于1943年投降后，德军接管意大利占领区。斜线标记国家参照，不表示占领者之间的边界。

title.zh: 希腊 · 占领与撤退

summary.en: German forces continued deportations and then withdrew from much of Greece during 1944. This marker identifies Athens as a reference for changing country-wide conditions, not a mapped front or the state of every island.
summary.zh: 1944年德军继续驱逐行动，随后从希腊大部分地区撤退。此点以雅典代表全国不断变化的状况，不是战线，也不表示每座岛屿的情况。

title.en: Prague · Bohemia and Moravia under occupation
title.zh: 布拉格 · 波希米亚和摩拉维亚遭占领

summary.en: After the partition of Czechoslovakia in 1938–39, the German-controlled Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia had a different status from Slovakia. From 1941 German authorities deported Czech Jews via Theresienstadt to killing sites. The Prague marker is not a border for the protectorate or the former republic.
summary.zh: 1938—1939年捷克斯洛伐克被瓜分后，德国控制的波希米亚和摩拉维亚保护国与斯洛伐克的地位不同。1941年起德国当局将捷克犹太人经由特雷津驱逐至杀戮地点。布拉格标记不代表保护国或原共和国的边界。

title.zh: 南京 · 大屠杀与战时统治

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Nanjing on 13 December 1937; killings and sexual violence targeted civilians and disarmed soldiers. A Japanese-influenced Chinese administration emerged by February 1938. A scholarly abstract discusses student protests under the Japanese-backed Wang Jingwei government during 1940–45. The death toll is not settled; this point does not map occupied China.
summary.zh: 日军于1937年12月13日占领南京；平民与已解除武装的士兵遭到杀戮和性暴力。到1938年2月，受日本影响的中国行政机构出现。一篇学术摘要讨论1940—1945年汪精卫亲日政权下的学生抗议。死亡人数尚无定论；此点不绘制中国的占领范围。

title.zh: 香港 · 日军占领

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked on 8 December 1941 and the defenders surrendered on 25 December. Occupation brought acute shortages and lasted until Japan's surrender in 1945. This marker is a place reference, not a boundary for surrounding China.
summary.zh: 日军于1941年12月8日进攻，守军于12月25日投降。占领期间物资严重短缺，直至日本1945年投降。此标记为地点参照，不表示周边中国地区的边界。

title.zh: 新加坡 · 占领与肃清

summary.en: British forces surrendered on 15 February 1942. Japanese authorities screened Chinese men during Sook Ching from 21 February to 4 March; people judged suspect were killed. The point is Singapore, not the extent of Japanese control in Southeast Asia.
summary.zh: 英军于1942年2月15日投降。日方于2月21日至3月4日的肃清行动中筛查华人男性，被认定可疑者遭杀害。此点代表新加坡，并非日本在东南亚的全部控制范围。

title.zh: 打拉根 · 日军占领

summary.en: Japan occupied Tarakan in early 1942. Australian forces landed on 1 May 1945 and fighting inland continued until August. The marker identifies this island; it does not imply uniform occupation across Borneo or the Dutch East Indies.
summary.zh: 日本于1942年初占领打拉根。澳军于1945年5月1日登陆，内陆战斗持续至8月。标记仅代表这一岛屿，不表示婆罗洲或荷属东印度各地受到一致占领。

title.zh: 马尼拉 · 占领与抵抗

summary.en: Japanese occupation brought civilian abuses and resistance. A Japanese-sponsored Philippine government declared independence in 1943; Allied landings began in 1944, while Manila remained under Japanese control until the 1945 battle. The city marker does not map the whole archipelago.
summary.zh: 日本占领带来对平民的暴行与抵抗。日本扶持的菲律宾政府于1943年宣布独立；盟军于1944年开始登陆，马尼拉仍由日方控制，直至1945年战役。城市标记不绘制整个群岛的控制范围。

title.zh: 荷兰 · 解放与饥荒

summary.en: Fighting continued in 1945 as Allied forces advanced. In the western Netherlands, people faced starvation and food was delivered under a ceasefire. This marker recalls events during the year; it does not imply occupation at year-end.
summary.zh: 盟军推进期间，战斗延续至1945年。荷兰西部居民面临饥饿，停火安排下物资得以送达。此标记回顾年内事件，并不表示年末仍被占领。

title.zh: 挪威 · 1945年解放

summary.en: German occupation ended after Germany surrendered in May 1945. This Oslo point marks a transition during the year, not a claim that Norway remained occupied at year-end.
summary.zh: 德国于1945年5月投降后，占领结束。此奥斯陆点标记年内转折，并不表示挪威年末仍被占领。

title.zh: 马尼拉 · 战役与平民大屠杀

summary.en: The 1945 battle to retake Manila brought extensive destruction and mass killing of civilians. The point marks the city and the events during that year, not occupation of the whole Philippines at year-end.
summary.zh: 1945年夺回马尼拉的战役造成广泛破坏与平民大规模死亡。此点标记城市与年内事件，不表示菲律宾全境年末仍被占领。

title.zh: 打拉根 · 1945年的战斗

summary.en: Australian forces landed on Tarakan on 1 May 1945; fighting inland continued until August. This island marker represents a changing situation during the year.
summary.zh: 澳军于1945年5月1日在打拉根登陆，内陆战斗持续至8月。此岛屿标记表示年内变化的局势。

title.zh: 香港 · 占领结束

summary.en: Japan’s surrender in 1945 ended the occupation of Hong Kong after years of hardship. The marker represents a transition during the year, not Japanese control at year-end.
summary.zh: 日本于1945年投降，结束香港多年的占领与艰难生活。此标记表示年内转折，并不代表年末仍由日本控制。

title.zh: 新加坡 · 投降与占领结束

summary.en: Japanese forces formally surrendered to the Allies in Singapore on 12 September 1945. This marker records a transition during the year, not occupation at year-end.
summary.zh: 日军于1945年9月12日在新加坡正式向盟军投降。此标记记录年内转折，并不表示年末仍遭占领。

title.zh: 日本 · 盟军占领

summary.en: Japan announced its surrender in August 1945. An American-led Allied occupation reshaped Japan's government and continued until 1952. The country outline is a dated reference; it does not map every military installation or postwar territorial change.
summary.zh: 日本于1945年8月宣布投降。美国主导的盟军占领重塑了日本政府，并持续至1952年。国家轮廓为有年代的参照，未绘制每个军事设施或战后领土变化。

title.zh: 德国 · 西部占领区

summary.en: After Germany's 8 May 1945 surrender, the United States, Britain, France and the Soviet Union administered four zones. This CShapes unit combines the western zones; it does not separately reconstruct each zone or Berlin's four-power arrangements.
summary.zh: 德国于1945年5月8日投降后，美国、英国、法国与苏联分别管理四个占领区。此CShapes单元合并西部占领区；未分别重建各区或柏林的四国安排。

title.zh: 德国 · 苏联占领区

summary.en: After the May 1945 surrender, the Soviet Union administered one of Germany's four occupation zones. This is CShapes' source-coded zone reference, not an independently reconstructed boundary; Berlin had a separate four-power arrangement.
summary.zh: 1945年5月投降后，苏联管理德国四个占领区之一。此为CShapes来源编码的区域参照，并非独立重建的边界；柏林另有四国安排。
